name: Area access: teleports into locked Outland, Northrend, Blood Elf, Draenei and unreleased areas are refused
contract: With the shipped defaults every Coa.Access.* key is locked. Player::TeleportTo asks OnPlayerCanTeleportTo before the teleport has any effect, and AscensionAreaAccess refuses a non-GM destination whose map or zone is locked: Hellfire Peninsula (530, zone 3483), Dalaran (571, zone 4395), Silvermoon City (530, 3487), the Exodar (530, 3557), Shattrath (530, 3703), the Nexus dungeon map 576 and the unreleased Stormwind Sewers map 903. A refused player stays where they were. Without the feature each of these teleports lands on the destination map. A teleport to Stormwind proves the harness teleport works. Requires the source config to keep the default Coa.Access.* values (all locked).
